args.sql: SELECT session_telemetry->'session_stats' FROM security_sessions LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ss.acct_gate,
    (ss.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::int as session_count,
    ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'total_posts' as total_posts
FROM security_sessions ss
JOIN content_activity ca ON ss.acct_gate = ca.acct_slot
WHERE (ss.session_telemetry->'session_stats'->>'session_count')::int > 1000 
   OR (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'total_posts')::int > 50
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    ca.acct_slot,
    (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::float as posts_per_day,
    (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'total_posts')::int as total_posts
FROM content_activity ca
WHERE (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (ca.content_metrics->'posting'->>'posts_per_day')::float DESC
LIMIT 10;
